findings.summary: The merge assumes one row per customer_id in segments; duplicate customers cause their orders to be joined multiple times, silently double-counting revenue.
Using how="inner" drops orders whose customer is missing from segments, so per-segment totals don't sum to total revenue and nothing flags the gap.
groupby drops rows with a null segment by default, so if switching to a left join without filling nulls, dropna=False is needed to keep that revenue.
